value: U.S. Department of Energy, Advanced Manufacturing Office (2015). Bandwidth Study on Energy Use and Potential Energy Saving Opportunities in U.S. Pulp and Paper Manufacturing. Prepared by Energetics Incorporated (T. Miller, C. Kramer, A. Fisher). Washington, DC: U.S. DOE.

CT -> variant efficiency-base; SOA -> bat; PM -> efficiency-strong (R&D, not commercial). The thermodynamic minimum is a physical floor, not a technology, and sits in _thermodynamic-minimum. PM rows carry the PM lower limit as value and the SOA value as max, since the study defines the PM band as SOA down to the lower limit.

MMBtu per SHORT ton (2,000 lb), as printed; the table gives no metric equivalent. 1 MMBtu/short ton = 1.163 GJ/tonne. Onsite energy, excluding the powerhouse, whose steam and power are counted at the point of use.
